decisions.reason: As a multi-model illustrated release series that fits our curation and label capabilities, it likely meets aspiration levels well enough in a growing market and does not justify reallocating resources.
The reissued jazz vinyl LP extends our established reissue strengths into a collector-friendly format, so with no clear shortfall versus aspirations we would continue it while learning from demand.
A multi-disc box set matches our specialist audience and production know-how, and although it ties up more capital than simpler releases, available slack and strategic fit favor keeping it.

This compilation CD looks less differentiated and more weakly committed than our stronger releases, so if results lag aspiration levels we would redirect resources to the core catalog and new development.
